description: Tess OS second brain (scripts/brain/tessbrain.py). Codex runs project hooks only after the project is trusted and these hooks are approved in /hooks; approval is hash-pinned, so these lines never change.

hooks.command: sh -c 'exec python3 "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/scripts/brain/tessbrain.py" hook session-start --runtime codex'
sh -c 'exec python3 "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/scripts/brain/tessbrain.py" hook prompt --runtime codex'
sh -c 'exec python3 "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/scripts/brain/tessbrain.py" hook stop --runtime codex'
